entries.proposition: GENE ATTRIBUTION, read: p.E17K is a WWOX variant (c.49G>A); the other worked variant, p.Cys121Trp, is in SCN1B.
entries.snippet: FoundHaplo was used to predict carriers of the SCN1B c.363C>G (p.Cys121Trp) (OMIM: 604233) and WWOX c.49G>A (p.E17K) (OMIM: 616211) rare variants in two cohorts.
entries.anchor: Materials and methods, 'Detecting the SCN1B c.363C>G and WWOX c.49G>A rare epilepsy variants'

entries.proposition: PATHOGENICITY IS INHERITED BY CITATION, and the population frequency is stated.
entries.snippet: WWOX c.49G>A has a MAF of 0.01037% in gnomAD [46, 47] and causes autosomal recessive developmental and epileptic encephalopathy [52–54].

entries.proposition: HETEROZYGOTE COUNT: 172 UK Biobank participants carry the WWOX variant by WES; zygosity per carrier is not stated, and no phenotype of any carrier is reported anywhere in the paper.
entries.snippet: identified two individuals in the Epi25 cohort and 171 individuals in the UKBB cohort who carried the SCN1B c.363C>G variant and 172 individuals in the UKBB who carried the WWOX c.49G>A variant

entries.proposition: FOUNDER: all carriers share a core haplotype around the WWOX variant, so its recurrence across reports is one ancestral allele, not repeated mutation.
entries.snippet: All of the 175 WWOX c.49G>A carriers shared a core haplotype of 157 kb.
entries.anchor: Results, 'Detecting individuals with the SCN1B c.363C>G and WWOX c.49G>A rare epilepsy variants'

entries.proposition: NO CARRIER IN THE EPILEPSY COHORT: zero WWOX c.49G>A carriers among 1,573 epilepsy patients. At the UKBB carrier rate (172 of 468,481) about 0.6 carriers would be expected in 1,573 people (reader's arithmetic), so the zero is uninformative.
entries.snippet: There are no WWOX c.49G>A carriers in the Epi25 cohort, but FoundHaplo identified 23 noncarriers (1.5% false positive rate).

entries.proposition: THE DISEASE HAPLOTYPES COME FROM THREE AFFECTED-CHILD/PARENT DUOS recruited by the same clinical research centre as the held WWOX-DEE cohort; the affected children's second allele and zygosity are not stated.
entries.snippet: The WWOX c.49G>A (p.E17K) disease haplotypes were derived from a cohort of three
entries.anchor: Supplementary Note 3, 'Deriving the SCN1B c.363C>G and WWOX c.49G>A disease haplotypes'

entries.proposition: VARIANT CONFIRMATION in the six duo members by WES.
entries.snippet: c.49G>A disease variant was confirmed in all six individuals through WES.

entries.proposition: FOUNDER-ORIGIN CITATION: the supplement's founder table gives WWOX c.49G>A a named founder population and cites its reference 21 (Weisz-Hubshman 2019) for it; the population label is not reproduced in this public edition. The held text layer of that paper does not name c.49G>A or Glu17 (see intake note); the attribution is not supported by the source it cites.
